directPaymentDiscovery.scope: Current official VWEW public charging tariff page for publicly accessible VWEW charging stations
directPaymentDiscovery.note: The current official HTML page is authoritative for this first pass. A still-indexed 01/2025 PDF lists 0.39 EUR/kWh AC for QR/intercharge direct, so that older PDF is retained only as historical evidence and is not promoted over the current page.

reason: Current official operator page explicitly labels QR-code and intercharge direct prices without VWEW card and gives AC/DC energy prices plus occupancy price, so the direct public tariff can be captured without station or roaming extrapolation.
